the effect of outpatient facilities on patient safety, experience and service availability is unknown because the evidence is of low quality and insufficient to draw conclusions about the effect of specific facility characteristics.

the effects of facility characteristics, such as accreditation and emergency response protocols, on patient safety, the patient experience, and the availability of services.
the effects of facility requirements on patient safety, experience, and availability for procedures in outpatient settings.
